authority.service: current User re-read; active status; WORKSPACE_ADMIN+; claim is_active/status/role/raw tenant/raw workspace in the delete transaction

routes.states: verified; already_applied; refused (404/400/403); conflict (409 STALE_TARGET/AUTHORITY_CHANGED/OPERATION_CONFLICT); not_applied (409); committed_unverified (503); effect_unknown (503)

receipt.readback: fresh session; audit fields, target absence, dependent counts and tombstone must match
